source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: The very first verse indicates that this Surah was revealed on the occasion of Mi\`raj (Ascension). According to the Traditions and books on the life of the Holy Prophet, this event happened one year before Hijrah.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Topics
theme.text: This Surah is a wonderful combination of warning, admonition and instruction, which have been blended together in a balanced proportion.
